summary: Kerb on a through road with no parked cars, retaining wall and steep grade.
reasons: Wall and narrow kerb, nowhere to pull out

drivers.seclusion: Grassed bank and school-type buildings to the west; homes 36 m or more away. Seclusion is not the problem.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed two-lane road with painted islands; kerb edge is narrow beside a retaining wall, so no room to pull out of the lane.
drivers.traffic: Through route with a junction and painted islands just ahead; steady traffic.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb and no marked parking lane.

sun_shade: Open to sun; light shade from trees on the south-west side.
